title: nasturtium suffruticosum
intro: Nasturtium suffruticosum, commonly known as Dwarf Tropaeolum, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Tropaeolaceae family. This plant is valued for its edible flowers, leaves, and seeds, which are rich in vitamins and minerals, making it a nutritious addition to salads and other culinary dishes. The health benefits of Nasturtium suffruticosum include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in soothing digestive issues and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, carotenoids, and glucosinolates, which have been shown to have therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties.
